OP.title: OP Operator administrator
OP.routine: Verify institutions and manage platform configuration
OP.conditions: No routine patient, model or sealed benchmark access

OA.title: OA Organisation administrator
OA.routine: Invite members and delegate approved institutional roles
OA.conditions: Cannot self-elevate, grant beyond delegation or impersonate a signer

PM.title: PM Programme manager
PM.routine: Manage calls, pipeline, scope, budget requests and study tasks
PM.conditions: Scientific, data and clinical approvals remain separate

CO.title: CO Country owner
CO.routine: Maintain applicability and local activation records
CO.conditions: Qualified local authority for each decision class must be recorded

DV.title: DV Developer
DV.routine: Maintain own product versions and respond to reviews
DV.conditions: Cannot view sealed labels or be sole final scientific approver

DC.title: DC Data custodian
DC.routine: Catalogue assets, approve grants and manage releases
DC.conditions: Rights and country restrictions apply even to asset owners

DE.title: DE Data engineer
DE.routine: Import, transform and reconcile assigned assets
DE.conditions: Cannot grant own access or declare clinical reference truth

AN.title: AN Annotator
AN.routine: Label assigned cases using approved guidance
AN.conditions: Blinding and professional qualification must be current

EV.title: EV Evaluator
EV.routine: Prepare protocols, execute allowed runs and analyse results
EV.conditions: Assigned study, purpose, training and competence required

SR.title: SR Independent reviewer
SR.routine: Review frozen evidence and sign eligible findings
SR.conditions: Independence, conflicts, credentials and recent authentication checked

PI.title: PI Site investigator
PI.routine: Manage authorised local study conduct and participants
PI.conditions: Site activation and local clinical authority required

CS.title: CS Clinical safety owner
CS.routine: Triage hazards, contain unsafe activity and coordinate reporting
CS.conditions: Resumption requires independent eligible review where applicable

ER.title: ER Ethics or authority reviewer
ER.routine: Review explicitly shared evidence and record issuer decisions
ER.conditions: Platform membership alone does not establish issuing authority

BY.title: BY Buyer or implementation owner
BY.routine: Assess costs, readiness and deployment acceptance

FN.title: FN Funder or finance owner
FN.routine: Manage agreed funding records and financial reporting
FN.conditions: No scientific editorial power or default clinical access

SO.title: SO Security and operations
SO.routine: Operate service, respond to incidents and manage credentials
SO.conditions: Sensitive content only through approved exceptional access

SU.title: SU Support agent
SU.conditions: Time limited case scope; no blanket tenant access

AU.title: AU Independent auditor
AU.routine: Read bounded audit and control evidence
AU.conditions: Cannot modify or approve the records being audited

CR.title: CR Community representative
CR.routine: Submit concerns and review approved consultation material
CR.conditions: Cannot inspect other participants or restricted studies

SV.title: SV Service identity
SV.routine: Execute approved connector or scheduled function
SV.conditions: Named owner, nonhuman credentials and explicit scopes
